title: Cultural Re-contextualization of Fairness Research in Language Technologies in India

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbation analysis using caste identity terms to measure shifts in sentiment scores on a fine-tuned sentiment model.
Perturbation analysis using regional identity terms to measure sentiment shifts, as well as evaluation using a human-curated dataset of regional stereotypes.
Perturbation analysis using religious identity terms to measure sentiment shifts, alongside evaluation against a human-curated dataset of religious stereotypes.
Using the DisCo metric with Indian and American names to measure statistically significant gender associations in masked language models.
